sections.heading: Summary
sections.markdown:
The following is a **Walkthrough** guide to Elden Ring.

The goal of this Walkthrough is to position the player in a way that they are able to complete the game without missing any content. It will not dictate equipment or quest choices, only highlight the options. It will also not specifically mention every item or other minor details.

sections.heading: Step 1: Chapel of Anticipation
sections.markdown:
Select whatever starting class and item you want. For more character statistics details, see Stats and Attributes.

Exit the chapel and head downstairs to the open plaza with a large statue. You will be attacked by a Grafted Scion. You likely can't beat this boss yet and even if you do, you will just fall off a cliff shortly thereafter.

sections.heading: Step 2: Limgrave
sections.markdown:
You wake up in the Stranded Graveyard. The game automatically hands you the flasks for HP and FP restoration.

In front of the spirit on a chair is a cave that you can jump down to. That's the tutorial area. Once you complete it, you will end up back at the spirit on the chair. Now head upstairs and ascend with the elevator, then go outside.

You'll be greeted by White-Faced Varré. You can talk to him for some exposition or just ignore him. Activate the Site of Grace, then sneak past the Tree Sentinel knight uphill to the Church of Elleh, where you will find the merchant Kalé and another grace. If you can, buy the crafting kit from Kalé.

Next travel through the forest to the north-west. You'll arrive at a soldier camp. Clear it or skip it, then pick up the Limgrave Map at the street and activate the nearby Gatefront Ruins grace. Melina will show up. Simply accept her accord, you can't beat the game without it anyway. Melina will give you the Spectral Steed Whistle for Torrent.

Use Torrent to travel south-east along the road up until you hear an npc speak. That npc is Boc and he is camouflaged as a bush. Attack or roll into the bush and talk to Boc. He'll tell you about a cave at the shore south-west of the church where you met Kale. We'll go there soon.

For now we want to go further east, across the bridge that is going to be occupied by a Night's Cavalry. Either wait until morning at a grace or sneak past it, because it is unlikely that you can defeat it yet.

Follow the road down up until you see a bunch of ruins on a hill to the north-east. Make your way past the giant plants and down into the cellar, where there is a Mad Pumpkin Head miniboss. Defeat it and activate the grace. In the room at the end of the cellar is Sellen. You can buy some sorcery Spells from her should you need any, but it is preferable to spend your Runes on leveling up.

Proceed further down the road to the southern end of the lake. There will be the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace at the foot of the hill, not far from where there is a Teardrop Scarab with the Ash of War: Unsheathe in the lake. Travel west to the large ruin. Beneath it is Bloody Finger Hunter Yura. Relevant for casters: east of the Agheel Lake site of grace is an enemy camp with the Royal House Scroll.

Yura will warn you of a dragon in the lake. We will cross the lake regardless, but avoid the dragon for now by sticking to the cliff on the west end of the lake. Travel all the way north-west in the lake to the mining cave. Skip the crab enemies, none of them are worth fighting.

Clear the entire mining cave. The yellow stones on the walls are free Smithing Stones, pick them up. At the end of the cave is a Stonedigger Troll miniboss. Defeat it.

Now warp back to the Church of Elleh and use the anvil there to upgrade your weapon to +3. Should you have missed some Smithing Stone 1s in the cave, you can buy a few more from the merchant at the shore south-west. Buy the crafting kit if you haven't already. Use any remaining Runes to level up.

Now travel to the north-west. There is a dungeon inside of the cliff with a watchdog miniboss at the end. Clear it and use the runes to level up.

Next go down to the shore mentioned earlier and visit Boc in the Demi-human cave, not far from where the merchant is. Talk to Boc, then defeat the miniboss in the cave to reclaim his sewing needle and give it to him. You can also proceed past the miniboss arena to the small island in the south, where there is a grace in front of the Church of Dragon Communication.

Relevant for melee users: it is now worth picking up Armorer's Cookbook 1 from a small enemy camp north-east of the Gatefront Ruins, west of the bridge. It can be used to craft Fire Grease.

Warp to the Waypoint Ruins with Sellen, but now travel north instead of south and follow the road to the north-east. There will be the Mistwood Outskirts grace on the right-hand side. On top of another large ruin similar to the one you found Yura beneath will be Kenneth Haight. Talk to him, then follow the road again until you reach the Third Church of Marika. Here you'll find your Flask of Wondrous Physick and a Sacred Tear to upgrade your regular flasks at the grace. Melina will also offer some lore when talked to at the grace here.

Follow the path again up until you see the Minor Erdtree. Kill the Teardrop Scarab on the way up for the Ash of War: Ground Slam and pick up the Crystal Tears from a bowl behind the Minor Erdtree. Then return to the path and keep riding south until you reach Fort Haight. Activate the grace at the foot of the hill called Fort Haight West, then clear the entire fort. Relevant for melee users: you'll find the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook 6 here, which lets you craft Blood Grease. Fort Haight is also a good spot to farm Blood Roses for it. Once you have beaten the knight that drops Ash of War: Bloody Slash and picked up one half of the Dectus Medallion from the tower, return to Kenneth Haight and report your victory.

Return to Church of Elleh and talk to Kalé. He'll tell you about Blaidd and give you the Fingersnap Gesture. Return to the Mistwood Ruins and use it there, at the ruin with the large Runebear inside. Talk to Blaidd, then warp to the Agheel Lake South grace. Travel uphill to the Forlorn Hound Evergaol and defeat Bloodhound Knight Darriwil. You can summon Blaidd here if you so choose.

Level up again and travel all the way north through the lake, to the river beneath the bridge where the Night's Cavalry patrols. You will be invaded by an NPC here and Yura will come to your aid. Defeat the invader, then go all the way north to find Yura beneath the rock formation. Talk to him there, then go back south a little and enter the Murkwater Cave in the cliff to the east. Here you'll find Patches.

Now warp back to the Gatefront Ruins.

sections.heading: Step 3: Stormhill
sections.markdown:
Follow the path to the north-west up until you arrive at the Stormhill Shack. Pick up the Golden Seed, unlock the grace and upgrade your flask. Then talk to Roderika in the Shack. Now travel all the way east to the Warmaster's Shack. Here you'll meet Bernahl. You can also farm infinite Root Resin here for Blood/Fire Grease.

Continue further east until you can climb uphill to the Deathtouched Catacombs. You'll meet Iron Fist Alexander on the way there. Clear the catacombs, return to the road and travel further east to Summonwater Village. You'll meet D (NPC) on the way. Defeat the Tibia Mariner and talk to D in the village. You can pick up the Green Turtle Talisman here from an underground room. Level up, then warp to the Third Church of Marika and use the hidden gateway portal north of it in the lake. D should have made a marker for it on your map. It will warp you all the way to Caelid. Don't bother with the Black Blade Kindred, it will oneshot you since you are severely underleveled for this area. Simply enter the Bestial Sanctum and talk to the Beast Clergyman. If you so choose, you can also travel south from here to pick up another Golden Seed and farm the Vulgar Militia enemies for Runes, they are relatively weak and drop around 1000 each. This is the best spot for Rune farming early game.

Warp back to the Stormveil Shack in Limgrave, then follow the road north. Kill the Teardrop Scarab for Ash of War: Wild Strikes on the way. Run past the enemies, unlock the Castleward Tunnel grace and talk to Melina. You can attempt to fight the boss here, but are unlikely to be able to defeat it yet unless you farmed the Vulgar Militia enemies.

First warp back to the Warmaster's Shack and ride up the hill to the north, then all the way to the cliff in the east to pick up the Lance Talisman. It will help you a lot when fighting large enemies on horseback. Now return to the Agheel Lake grace and defeat the Flying Dragon Agheel.

Afterwards, level up and travel south from the lake through the ravine and over the bridge.

sections.heading: Step 4: Weeping Peninsula
sections.markdown:
Run past the enemies on the Bridge of Sacrifice, then unlock the grace with the same name to your right. A little further south beneath a bridge is Irina. Talk to her and accept her request to deliver a letter to her father, Edgar. Continue further south until you find a merchant next to the Castle Morne Rampart grace. Head a little further south to where a giant will shoot arrows at you. Don't approach him yet, simply pick up the Golden Seed on the hill and travel back to the north-west until you arrive at the South of the Lookout Tower grace. Ride west through the Demi-human Forest until you cross a bridge, then travel north to the Church of Pilgrimage. Pick up another Sacred Tear for your flask, then ride south to the Minor Erdtree and defeat the Erdtree Avatar there.

Afterwards, keep traveling south-west until you see the Walking Mausoleum. Ride towards it and then uphill to the west until you arrive at the Fourth Church of Marika. You can talk to Melina again here and pick up another Sacred Tear. Near the church to the north is an Evergaol miniboss and a poison filled cave. Clear them if you want, otherwise just travel south past the Witchbane Ruins until you arrive at the Isolated Merchant's Shack. The merchant here sells a couple relevant items, most notably the Lantern. If you are short on runes, simply warp to Caelid, kill two Vulgar Militiamen and warp back.

Now warp to the Castle Morne Rampart grace with the merchant again and ride south towards the giant that fired arrows at you earlier. Defeat him and continue into Castle Morne. Activate the grace, then go up the elevator. You can pick up some items here or just run past all the enemies to the ladder in the back. Explore the area until you find Edgar. Give him Irina's letter, then explore the southern end of the Castle, unlock the grace there and jump down several platforms until you arrive at the shore and activate the grace here as well.

At the shore is a boss fog with the Leonine Misbegotten. The key to defeating this enemy is figuring out how you can stun it, since it will be attacking non-stop otherwise and hits relatively hard. For most melee weapons, that means having to wait for an opening to use heavy attacks. It drops the Grafted Blade Greatsword when defeated, which is the legendary weapon that Edgar was talking about. Report back to Edgar and visit Irina at the Bridge of Sacrifice.

Clear up the remaining optional bosses. Return to Limgrave and defeat the Tree Sentinel, then also the Night's Cavalry on the bridge, as well as the Night's Cavalry near the merchant in the central Weeping Peninsula.

sections.heading: Step 5: Stormveil Castle
sections.markdown:
Spend all your remaining Runes to buy Margit's Shackle from Patches (or just farm Militiamen for it), then warp to the Castleward Tunnel grace. It is time to fight Margit the Fell Omen.

Regardless of whether or not you beat Margit on your first try, Melina will now warp you to the Roundtable Hold the next time you sit at a grace, if she hasn't done so already. Speak to every npc there, but don't hold on to Fia's Baldachin's Blessing. Now wait until night-time and warp to the Church of Elleh, where you will meet Lunar Princess Ranni. She gives you the Spirit Calling Bell and Lone Wolf Ashes.

If you still can't seem to defeat Margit, you can skip ahead to Step 6 and return to Stormveil Castle a little later.

After defeating Margit, you will arrive at the Stormveil Main Gate and meet Gostoc the Gatekeeper. Have him open the main gate for you, then proceed past the hole in the wall next to Gostoc regardless. You can backtrack at specific points to confront Gostoc about stalking you. If you don't do this twice, he will keep stealing a portion of your dropped Runes every time you die within Stormveil Castle. Gostoc will also lock you in a room with a Banished Knight, where the Rusty Key is. After acquiring the Rusty Key, you can talk to Gostoc again at the main gate and buy items from him. If you enjoy Parrying enemies early game, it is highly recommended to buy the Buckler from him. Do not kill Gostoc.

Explore all of Stormveil Castle until you have met both Rogier and Nepheli Loux. There is going to be another Golden Seed not far from where you find Nepheli. You can also fight an optional Ulcerated Tree Spirit miniboss, as well as a Grafted Scion and a Crucible Knight in the castle. Once done with everything, it is time to fight Godrick the Grafted.

After defeating Godrick, pick up the Shabriri Grape from the room beneath the Stormveil Castle throne room and exit the castle to the north.

sections.heading: Step 6: Liurnia of the Lakes
sections.markdown:
Touch the Lake-Facing Cliffs grace and talk to both Hyetta and Boc there. Give Hyetta the Shabriri Grape you just picked up. Then meet Thops in the Church of Irith. Travel down into the lake and touch the Liurnia Lake Shore grace next to the merchant. He sells more Smithing Stones, should you need any.

Immediately north-west of the merchant is the Malefactor's Evergaol that you can jump up to with a Spiritspring Jump on horseback from the lake. Defeat Adan Thief of Fire and travel further north into the lake. Touch the Laskyar Ruins grace and rest, then travel straight east to the Purified Ruins where Hyetta is standing at the shore. You probably don't have another Shabriri Grape for her yet, so just travel north-east from there and touch the Liurnia Highway North grace. You can travel south-east from here to the Cliffbottom Catacombs, but it is not important.

First go back into the lake and travel north from the Laskyar Ruins to where you can pick up them map. You can find Rya nearby at a pavilion. Accept her request to retrieve her necklace, then travel west to the Scenic Isle, where you'll run into Patches again. He isn't the guy who stole her necklace however. Travel directly north from where you met Patches to the Boilprawn Shack where Blackguard Big Boggart resides. He has her necklace, but won't give it to you unless you give him 1000 Runes. He has his own little quest, so killing him is not recommended. Rather just unlock the Boilprawn Shack grace and fast travel to the Dragonbarrow again to kill a Vulgar Militia, then buy it from him.

Ride north to the Academy Gate Town and unlock the grace there, then continue further north to meet Diallos Hoslow. Talk to him and ride far into the west until you arrive at either the Rose Church or the Temple Quarter. White-Faced Varré will be at the Rose Church and hand you some Festering Bloody Fingers for PvP invasions. You have to use them to continue his quest, although the only thing you get for doing it are PvP items and Varré's Bouquet very late into the game. If you have found enough Smithing Stone 2s to upgrade your weapons again, now is the time.

Ride further west from there and go back on land, then find the Revenger's Shack Site of Grace, south of the Cuckoo's Evergaol. Defeat Edgar, then bring his Shabriri Grape to Hyetta at the Purified Ruins. You can also pick up the third Shabriri Grape from the ruins further uphill.

Warp back to the Revenger's Shack and then travel south to the Minor Erdtree to defeat the Erdtree Avatar there and north to defeat Bols, Carian Knight at the Evergaol, in whatever order you want. Warp to the Boilprawn Shack and ride south-west to the poison-swamp part of the lake. Meet Nepheli Loux at the village and defeat the Omenkiller with or without her.

Level up and ride north-east from the Cuckoo's Evergaol. Defeat Glintstone Dragon Smarag and pick up the Academy Glintstone Key. Travel north-east from there and clear the Academy Crystal Cave, at the bottom of the cliff on the western side of the academy.

Then ride all the way around the academy to the north-eastern end of the lake, directly east of the large broken bridge, and enter the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel. Clear the dungeon for the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [1] and a bunch of different Smithing Stones along the way. Upgrade your weapons again, then warp to the Academy Gate Town and enter the academy from there.

sections.heading: Step 7: Academy of Raya Lucaria
sections.markdown:
Touch the grace, then run past the seal to the north out onto the bridge. You'll find a red summon sign for Bloody Finger Hunter Yura's quest. Complete the invasion and talk to Yura at the bridge.

Past the seal to the south is merchant hidden among the trees and even further down the path a Celestial Dew guarded by a Bloodhound Knight.

Enter the elevator next to the grace and fight your way through the academy. Once near the boss fog, use Margit's Shackle to remove illusory walls and pick up some hidden items. Defeat the Red Wolf of Radagon and level up again.

Go outside to where the Abductor Virgin patrols a plaza, but run upstairs and jump down a railing onto another set of stairs. Kill the mages, go downstairs and open the door for a shortcut, then go upstairs again and jump down onto the rooftops. Descend from there until you reach the Church of the Cuckoo. Enter the building through a window and position yourself on the wooden beams to jump down onto the chandelier that holds an item. It's the second Academy Glintstone Key for Thops. Then jump over to the upper level and kick down the ladder for a shortcut. Go outside from the upper level and descend from there to kill a crystal crab, which drops the Twinsage Glintstone Crown.

Now return to the Debate Parlor where you fought the Red Wolf and run across the plaza to the rafters. Jump over to the bridge and dodge the giant rolling globes. Defeat Moongrum, Carian Knight and head to the east to unlock a shortcut by opening a door. Then take the gateway portal to the Church of Vows and touch the grace there. Return to the Debate Parlor again and make your way to the elevator where you defeated Moongrum and ascend to the Grand Library, where you have to fight and defeat Queen Rennala.

Warp back to the Church where you met Thops and give him the Glintstone Key, then warp to the Academy's Schoolhouse Classroom grace and check on him outside of the building (he is dead).

sections.heading: Step 8: Caria Manor
sections.markdown:
Warp to the Main Academy Gate grace and exit through the northern seal. Touch the East Raya Lucaria Gate grace and talk to Melina and Boc.

Visit the Roundtable and talk to everyone again. Finger Reader Enia will give you your third Talisman Pouch. Fia will have new dialogue if you let her hold you. Get the note from her on where to find the Black Knifeprint and travel to the Church of Vows. Ride north through the Uld Palace Ruins and up to the Minor Erdtree. Defeat the Erdtree Avatar there, then jump down to the north-east from there to continue further north and enter the Black Knife Catacombs. There will be a Black Knife Assassin miniboss hidden behind an illusory wall that you can dispel with Margit's Shackle as usual. You can summon D (NPC) for this boss.

Afterwards, give the knifeprint to Rogier and warp to the Revenger's Shack in west-Liurnia again. Now travel north to the Four Belfries, touch the grace at the top of the mountain, then warp back down again and continue further north to the Kingsrealm Ruins. Use Margit's Shackle again to dispel another illusory wall to the north. Unlock the Road to the Manor grace and talk to War Counselor Iji. Mention that Blaidd sent you.

Ride north to the manor and dodge the sorcery rain. Touch the Main Caria Manor Gate grace and prepare Fire Pots or Fire Grease. Enter the manor and kill the Fingercreepers with fire. Loot the whole place and touch the Manor Lower Level grace. There is a branching path here, one leads deeper into the manor, the other lets you jump down onto a rooftop and pick up the Sword of Night and Flame.

Move on to the Manor Upper Level, pick up the Golden Seed, defeat the Troll Knight for the Troll Knight's Sword. You can exit to the left before the boss room and jump down several levels at the graveyard with pot enemies to pick up more items.

Defeat the area boss, Royal Knight Loretta. Before moving on, warp back to the Roundtable and hear the news from Rogier about the Knifeprint. Then return to the manor and continue to the Three Sisters. Fight the Glintstone Dragon Adula. It will run away once dropping to 50%. Enter Ranni's Rise and confront her about the Night of the Black Knives. She tells you to get lost, so return to Rogier, hear his proposition, then return to Ranni again and become one of her vassals. Speak with War Counselor Iji, Blaidd and Seluvis in Ranni's Rise, then talk to Ranni again. Ranni sends you and Blaidd on a mission to find the Fingerslayer Blade in Nokron.

sections.heading: Step 9: Siofra River
sections.markdown:
Warp to the Mistwood Ruins in Limgrave where you first met Blaidd, then take the elevator in the building near the Minor Erdtree down to the Siofra River. Clear the area, touch the Siofra River Bank grace and jump up the ledge to the west to pick up the Armorer's Cookbook 6, which lets you craft Preserving Boluses. You can farm the Crystal Cave Moss for it at the Academy Crystal Cave in Liurnia of the Lakes.

You'll find Blaidd at the cliff north of the Hallowhorn Grounds. He'll tell you speak with Seluvis to get info on Nokron, Eternal City. Clear the rest of the area and light all the fireplaces to fight the Ancestor Spirit boss. You can also take a gateway portal on top of a ruin in the central-east side where all the archers are, which leads you to the Dragonkin Soldier boss.

Level up, warp back to Ranni's Rise and meet Seluvis. While at it, also check on Pidia, who you'll need to jump down to from the cliff not far from where you find Seluvis. Seluvis tells you to ask Sellen about Nokron. Sellen in turn says that you have to defeat General Radahn in Caelid to be able to reach Nokron. You may also take Seluvis's Potion from him. Do not give the potion to anyone just yet. Report back to Blaidd.

sections.heading: Step 10: Caelid
sections.markdown:
Travel to the Summonwater Village in Limgrave and ride to the east. Touch the Smoldering Church grace and pick up the two cookbooks. Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater will invade you there.

Keep following the road, first to the east up until the Caelem Ruins and then south until the Caelid Waypoint Ruins. Skip the Decaying Ekzykes dragon fight for now and also avoid the Aeonia swamp. Naturally, you touch every grace you come across. Stay on the road until you pass the Sellia Gateway. There will be an NPC message and a shack guarded by a large dog. Sneak past the dog and talk to Gowry.

To complete Gowry's request, you need to defeat Commander O'Niel in the Aeonia swamp. Bring lots of Preserving Boluses, because you will have to fight a Millicent invader on the way there. When the invasion begins, you get automatically dismounted. Run back to the shore, cure the Scarlet Rot and fight her on land. You'll need lots of space to dodge her Waterfowl Dance attack.

Get the Unalloyed Gold Needle and bring it to Gowry. He'll take it and repair it. In the meantime, warp back to west-Caelid and travel all the way to the south-west to Fort Gael. Clear the fort and take the gateway portal to Redmane Castle. Activate the Redmane Castle Plaza grace and return to Gowry.

Now ride north from Gowry's Shack into Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Light all three fires, loot the place, defeat the Nox Swordstress and Nox Priestess duo miniboss, pick up the Golden Seed and exit the town to the north. Activate the Sellia Backstreets grace, ascent the mountain and meet Millicent at the Church of the Plague. Talk to her, give her the needle, rest, then talk to her again at the church and another time at Gowry's Shack. Now ride further north past all the dragons to Fort Faroth. Clear the fort and pick up the second half of the Dectus Medallion.

Now warp all the way back to Liurnia of the Lakes. If you haven't done it yet, bring Rya her necklace. Otherwise go straight to the East Raya Lucaria Gate grace and ride north. Stop by at the Bellum Church to talk to Hyetta again, then continue up the mountain to the north-east and clear out the Frenzied Flame Village for the Fingerprint Grape.

Move on to the Grand Lift of Dectus in the north of Liurnia and activate it. Follow the road to the Altus Highway Junction grace and activate it, then warp back to Redmane Castle and meet Blaidd and Iron Fist Alexander at the plaza. Talk to Finger Maiden Thorelina to receive the Polite Bow gesture. Then talk to Witch-Hunter Jerren to initiate the Radahn boss fight. Pick up all the items at the plaza, since some parts of it will be locked once you defeat Radahn.

You can summon infinite npc phantoms during the fight against Radahn, up to 5 at a time. If you summon Great Horned Tragoth, he gives you the Casual Greeting gesture. Defeat Radahn and talk to both Blaidd and Alexander. Activate the grace, level up and ride all the way to the north-east, alonside the shoreline. Inside the cliff are the War-Dead Catacombs. You can clear it now or later.

sections.heading: Step 11: Altus Plateau
sections.markdown:
We're taking a detour to the Altus Plateau before finishing Ranni's mission. Talk to the Roundtable NPCs again. Take the dagger from Fia and give it to D. Warp to the Highway Junction grace. You'll meet Corhyn on the road right next to the Altus Plateau map. He is looking for Goldmask.

Jump off the road to the west and search for the Second Church of Marika. You'll find Bloody Finger Hunter Yura there again. Defeat the invader, Eleonora, and then continue north. Once you see a long bridge to the west, quickly go to the other side, touch the Bridge of Iniquity grace and then go back to the Altus Plateau and keep riding north until along the road you reach the Road of Iniquity Site of Grace. Goldmask is right above this road. Keep following the road to the north-east to the Windmill Village. Meet Goldmask on the bridge and defeat the Godskin Apostle at the village. Then return to Corhyn and let him know about Goldmask's location.

You can explore the central area down the broken bridge north of Corhyn, where there is a Minor Erdtree and the Wormface miniboss, but it's optional. Warp back to the Highway Junction grace and ride to the east up to the gigantic gate. Sneak past the Tree Sentinel duo and pick up the two Golden Seeds at the Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace. Follow the road to the south-east, leading to the Minor Erdtree Church. Talk to Melina at the grace and pick up the items there. Jump down to the lake north-east of the church and enter the Sealed Tunnel. Use Margit's Shackle again to dispel the illusory walls and pick up the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2]. Defeat the Onyx Lord at the end of the dungeon and activate the grace.

Warp back to the Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace, travel north to pick up more Golden Seeds and prepare for your rematch against Margit, The Fell Omen at the Outer Wall Battleground. Defeat him and stop by at the Hermit Merchant's Shack to the north-east, then go back to the Battleground. Leave the city wall to the north-west and travel south along the path all the way to the Sainted Hero's Grave on a hill. It will be guarded by a Black Knife Assassin that drops the Black Knife. Clear the Sainted Hero's Grave or leave it for later. South of it is the Stormcaller Church with another Sacred Tear.

Now warp back to Liurnia of the Lakes and ride to the north-end of the lake. Touch the "The Ravine" and "Ruin-Strewn Precipice" Sites of Grace on the way, then take the elevator to the mining cave and clear it to reach the "Ravine-Veiled Village" grace. Fight your way past the harpies. Near the boss fog is a ladder that leads to a Giant Land Octopus that guards the Serpent-God's Curved Sword. If you didn't already summon Great Horned Tragoth against General Radahn, you can do so here for the "Casual Greeting" gesture. The boss is Magma Wyrm Makar. Defeat him and continue though the Ruin-Strewn Precipice until you arrive at the Altus Plateau again.

Touch the grace and walk up the mountain, where Ancient Dragon Lansseax will attack you. Hit him a few times until he flies away, then warp to the Sainted Hero's Grave, change the time of day to night-time at the grace and take the elevator back up. Ride uphill to the east, where Lansseax will attack you again, this time for real. Defeat the dragon.

sections.heading: Step 12: Nokron, Eternal City
sections.markdown:
It is time to finish Ranni's quest. Upgrade everything as far as you can, then travel to the Fort Haight grace in Limgrave. There is now a huge crater with floating rocks that you can jump down on. It leads you to the upper level of the Siofra River. Fight your way further down and defeat the Mimic Tear miniboss. Ride over the bridge and stick to the western side of the cliff until you reach the Ancestral Woods Site of Grace. You can light all 6 fireplaces here on the upper level of the Siofra River to fight the Regal Ancestor Spirit, or skip it and jump down onto the Night's Sacred Ground rooftops from the cliff at the Ancestral Woods grace.

Climb all the way down through Nokron. You'll find the Black Whetblade near an altar inside of a building. There is also a Stonesword Key imp statue with the Mimic Tear Ashes in a treasure chest behind it. Summoning the Mimic Tear will make most bosses significantly less difficult, decide for yourself if you want to make use of it or not. Exit the building where you found the Whetblade and touch the Night's Sacred Ground grace. There is a large open space with a dozen Silver Tear enemies. Simply run past them and pick up the Fingerslayer Blade from the treasure chest at the end, then escape via the gateway portal.

sections.heading: Step 13: Deeproot Depths
sections.markdown:
Talk to War Counselor Iji, then warp back to the Agheel lake grace in Limgrave and interact with the Evergaol where you fought Bloodhound Knight Darriwil. Blaidd is inside of it. Warp back to Iji and get an explanation from him. You can then return to Blaidd and free him or leave him locked up, doesn't make a difference. Also interact with Seluvis if you still want anything from him.

Warp to Ranni's Rise with the Fingerslayer Blade. She will give you the Carian Inverted Statue that you need to find the Cursemark. The next time you rest, Ranni is gone and both Pidia and Seluvis are dead.

Travel to the Carian Study Hall in the east of Liurnia of the Lakes, not far from the Church of Vows. First clear the place without using the Inverted Statue, then return to the entrance, use the statue and progress all the way to the other end. A Godskin Noble will attack you on your way to the Divine Tower of Liurnia. Defeat it, take the elevator up the tower and pick up Ranni's Cursemark of Death.

If you haven't already, check back on the Roundtable Hold NPCs now. Fia leaves the Roundtable Hold and both D (NPC) and Rogier are dead.

Warp back to the Ancestral Woods and ride north past the docile blue jellies. Touch the Aqueduct-Facing Cliffs grace and fight your way past the Crucible Knights. Defeat the Valiant Gargoyle duo and give D's Twinned Armor to the unresponsive NPC in front of the boss arena. Then walk to the end of the Great Waterfall Basin and interact with the coffin, which will take you to the Deeproot Depths.

You can fight the Erdtree Avatar for the Staff of the Avatar or just jump over the large roots to the north, past the giant ants. You can also pick up the legendary incantation Elden Stars from a ledge here. Continue north-west along the edge of the waterfall to the "The Nameless Eternal City" grace. You can jump one level down and further north-west until you run into Crucible Knight Siluria. The fight is optional, but behind the miniboss is a treasure chest with the Crucible Knight armor set.

Jump all the way up the roots to the east until you arrive at the "Across the Roots" grace. Fight Fia's Champions and touch the Prince of Death's Throne grace. Let Fia hold you and give her Ranni's Cursemark. Rest at the grace, then enter Fia's dream and defeat Lichdragon Fortissax. Pick up the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince and rest again. D's brother will show up and Fia is dead. Rest again to get the Inseparable Sword and Twinned Armor.

sections.heading: Step 14: Ainsel River
sections.markdown:
Warp back down to the "The Nameless Eternal City" grace and hop into the coffin elevator. Touch the first grace you come across and warp back to Ranni's Rise. Ride north to Renna's Rise and pick up the Snow Witch Robe from a treasure chest, then take the gateway portal. Pick up Miniature Ranni from a coffin and sit at the grace. Select the "Talk to Miniature Ranni" option repeatedly until Ranni starts talking back to you.

You can now clear the entire Ainsel River area. Either head straight to Nokstella, Eternal City, or take a detour and defeat the Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella first for some runes and a sorcery Spell.

You can fight your way through Nokstella, Eternal City for a Golden Seed, some Larval Tears and Moon of Nokstella, or just follow the river to the north and take the elevator down. Defeat the Baleful Shadow invader. Ranni will award you with the Discarded Palace Key. Take another elevator down. You'll arrive at the Lake of Rot.

Stock up on Preserving Boluses by crafting them. You can fight the Dragonkin Soldier and Alabaster Lord for the Alabaster Lord's Sword and Dragonscale Blade, or just loot the place and move south to the Grand Cloister grace. Jump down the platforms from the Grand Cloister grace. There is an optional Tree Spirit boss in the river of rot. You can also just skip it and move to the end of the river, where there is a coffin in front of a waterfall. Hop into the coffin to progress to the area boss, Astel Naturalborn of the Void.

Touch the grace after defeating the boss and warp back to the Academy's Grand Library with Queen Rennala. Pick up the Dark Moon Ring and warp back to Astel's boss arena. Continue to the elevator, which takes you to the Moonlight Altar. Move uphill to the Cathedral of Manus Celes and defeat Glintstone Dragon Adula. Touch the grace in the cathedral.

You can then do some optional content: the fight against Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader that awards you the Mimic Tear-level Black Knife Tiche summon, the Ranni's Dark Moon turtle puzzle, and some optional dragon fights for Dragon Hearts and the Cerulean Amber Medallion +2.

To finish Ranni's quest, jump down into the hole at the Cathedral of Manus Celes and interact with Ranni's puppet body in front of the slain Two-Fingers.

sections.heading: Step 15: Dragonbarrow
sections.markdown:
Warp to the Church of the Plague in Caelid and ride north uphill, until you find the Spiritspring Jump. Jump up on top of the giant white skull and loot the bodies there for some free Smithing Stone 7s.

Then continue north towards Fort Faroth again and kill the giant sleeping dragon, it will drop over 50,000 Runes. Note that you can accelerate the process by using a bleed weapon. You can also farm this dragon indefinitely by riding back to the grace just as it dies and rest before it drops the Dragon Heart. This gives you all the Runes, but not the Dragon Heart, causing the dragon to respawn. This is also an easy way to become overpowered early game on a second playthrough, since the dragon doesn't fight back and bleed deals so much damage to it.

Jump down the next Spiritspring Jump near the fort to the Minor Erdtree and defeat the Putrid Avatar.

Spend your runes to level up once again. You should be at minimum level 60 by now, probably over 70. Travel to the west and towards the Divine Tower. Climb up using Torrent's double jump and the ladders. Touch the grace, pick up Radahn's Great Rune, warp back to the grace and descend the tower via the platforming challenge. There is a shortcut that you can unlock by climbing up the ladder immediately after the first iron elevator. Defeat the Godskin Apostle at the bottom of the tower, pick up the Godslayer's Greatsword from the treasure chest behind it. Then use the teleporter to get sent back outside and continue further west until you find the Isolated Merchant that sells the Beast-Repellent Torch.

If you haven't used the elevator in the north at the bottom level in Siofra River yet, go and activate it. It requires a Stonesword Key, but sends you to the Dragonbarrow Area with the Knights of the Great Jar, from where you can get the Great-Jar's Arsenal talisman.

sections.heading: Step 16: Mt. Gelmir
sections.markdown:
Warp to the Altus Plateau and explore the western area until you find the Lux Ruins. Nearby will be a Golden Seed and the "Erdtree-Gazing Hill" grace. Talk to Millicent at the grace and then with Rya in the Lux Ruins, if you haven't already spoken to Rya after taking the Grand Lift of Dectus way back in Step 11.

Rya will teleport you to the Volcano Manor. Talk to Tanith and accept her offer to join the manor, there is no reason not to. Get the Drawing-Room Key from her and open all the doors. Pick up all the items in the manor and then go upstairs to fight Inquisitor Ghiza to get Ghiza's Wheel.

If you are short on Smithing Stones, warp back outside to the Erdtree-Grazing Hill grace and ride north through the ravine until you come across some trolls and the Old Altus Tunnel in the left side of the cliff. Clear the Old Altus Tunnel for some Smithing Stone 5s and Somber Smithing Stones 4, 5 and 6. If you need Smithing Stone 6s instead, go up one level to the Bridge of Iniquity, north of the Second Church of Marika, and fight your way up Mt. Gelmir to defeat the Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast. You can also follow the path after it to fight another Ulcerated Tree Spirit near the Road of Iniquity grace, not far from the Volcano Manor entrance.

Once you are ready, travel alongside the Seethewater River in the ravine further north-west of the Erdtree-Gazing Hill. You have to go all the way around Mt. Gelmir and the Volcano Manor to the north-west. Clear Fort Laiedd for the Prelate's Inferno Crozier and defeat the Magma Wyrm south of it. Talk to Iron Fist Alexander in the lava mass a little further south to get the Jar helmet. Keep on riding south until you arrive at the Hermit's Shack. Defeat the Demi-Human Queen miniboss and talk to Glintstone Sorcerer Azur for the Comet Azur sorcery.

We're taking a quick detour to do Sellen's quest. Meet her in the Waypoint Ruins and get the key to Lusat's seal. Then warp to the Church of the Plague in Caelid and travel north until you arrive at the graveyard where there is a Battlemage enemy. Use Margit's Shackle to remove the illusory wall that covers up the entrance to the Sellia Hideaway cave. Find Lusat to get Stars of Ruin. You can also fight the scarlet rot Crystalian trio at the end of the cave for the Crystal Torrent Spell.

Return to Sellen and have her send you to the Witchbane Ruins in the Weeping Peninsula. Talk to her there to get Sellen's Primal Glintstone. Reload the area to talk to Witch-Hunter Jerren as well. Now warp to Ranni's Rise and search for Seluvis's hideout north of it. Use Margit's Shackle if you're having trouble locating the illusory wall. Put Sellen's glintstone into the new body, exhaust her dialogue and then travel to Queen Rennala in the Academy. Outside the grand library are two summon signs. Make your choice on who you want to aid, Sellen or Jerren.

With that done, do the Volcano Manor assassination quest in Limgrave and return back to the manor. Talk to everyone again, then take the next set of missions. Warp to the Old Altus Tunnel and travel north towards the Shaded Castle and complete the invasion on your way there. Explore the Shaded Castle to find the Valkyrie's Prosthesis for Millicent, then defeat Elemer of the Briar. Warp to where you fought Magma Wyrm Makar and do Patches's Volcano Manor mission, which requires killing Great Horned Tragoth.

Report back to Tanith and the others. Explore the empty room near the grace inside of the manor, there is an illusory wall. Go deeper into the manor, fight the Bloodhound Knight, touch the grace further downstairs in the chapel. Go outside and clear the area. Defeat the Godskin Noble. You can proceed to clear out the rest of the area, but do not touch the gateway portal.

sections.heading: Step 17: Leyndell, Royal Capital
sections.markdown:
Warp to the merchant's shack near the battlegrounds where you had your rematch against Margit the Fell Omen. Wait until night-time and reload the area to fight the Bell Bearing Hunter. Then also ride north-east from there to fight the Death Rite Bird. Keep going east past the golems firing giant arrows and defeat the Draconic Tree Sentinel. Enter the capital and talk to Boc and Melina at the second grace. Fight your way all the way down to the main street where an Erdtree Avatar appears.

Right next to the Erdtree Avatar is the Avenue Balcony grace. This is where the area branches out. You can either follow the main street and clear out that part of the area, or go downstairs from the Avenue Balcony grace and climb down a well to the sewers, or climb up the giant stone dragon's wing to find the Fortified Manor and the Erdtree Sanctuary.

The sewers lead to the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds with the Dung Eater and Mohg, the Omen, while a spirit version of Godfrey awaits you at the Erdtree Sanctuary. Defeating the golden Godfrey is mandatory to progress and gives you the fourth Talisman Pouch, while the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds are optional content.

Inside of the Fortified Manor near the Erdtree Sanctuary is the red sign for Bernahl's Volcano Manor quest. There you will also find the Coded Sword, Hammer, and one of the paintings in the same room as the Fortified Manor grace.

Corhyn and Goldmask are in front of the closed-off colosseum uphill, past the roots that lead up to the Erdtree Sanctuary.

Once you defeat Godfrey, you can pick up the Bolt of Gransax and the Golden Order Principia prayerbook. Give the Principia prayerbook to Miriel, Pastor of Vows or Corhyn and learn the spell Law of Regression. If you don't have enough Intelligence to cast it, combine items and consumables that temporarily boost the stat, like the Intelligence-knot Crystal Tear, Twinsage Glintstone Crown, Stargazer Heirloom and Marika's Scarseal. Visit the Radagon statue that is next to the two Perfumer enemies down the elevator from the Erdtree Sanctuary and cast Law of Regression while standing on top of the artist's message there. Then report back to Goldmask and tell him about the secret to receive the Golden Order Totality gesture.

Past the Erdtree Sanctuary are the Queen's Bedchambers, where a Black Knife Assassin attacks. Right next to the Bedchambers is the foot of the Erdtree, where Morgott, the Omen King awaits you.

After defeating Morgott, talk to him, then visit the Erdtree and talk to Melina again at the grace.

sections.heading: Step 18: Forbidden Lands
sections.markdown:
To reach the Forbidden Lands and claim Morgott's Great Rune, warp back to the Avanue Balcony in Leyndell, Royal Capital and open the gate to the east. You'll have to fight your way past a bunch of Perfumers and Leonine Misbegotten.

Step onto the large elevator and descend to the Forbidden Lands. Touch the grace, then take the elevator up again and jump off immediately to pick up the Blade of Calling from a hidden room in the elevator shaft. Jump back down, call the elevator again and this time take the road towards the Divine Tower. When approacing the patrolling soldier, the area morphs into the Fell Twin boss arena. Defeat them, claim the Great Rune and teleport back to the Forbidden Lands grace.

The Forbidden Lands are full of Vulgar Militia ambushes. There aren't many items to pick up here, only a Golden Seed on the path and a Somber Smithing Stone inside of a giant skull, so you can mostly just ride past everything, but there is an optional night-time Night's Cavalry miniboss and the Black Blade Kindred at the end.

After defeating the Black Blade Kindred, touch the Grand Lift of Rold grace and take the lift up to the Mountaintops of the Giants.

sections.heading: Step 19: Mountaintops of the Giants
sections.markdown:
The first thing you should do here is pick up the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3] from the treasure chest in the Zamor Ruins immediately after the lift. You can also pick up the Zamor Ice Storm Spell in the ruins while at it. You don't have to fight any of the enemies here.

Ride north to the cliff with a bunch of fire mages. Stop by at the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs and touch the grace, then travel further north over the rock wall where a giant shoots arrows at you.

Once arriving at the other end, you can spot a Teardrop Scarab that will drop a Somber Smithing Stone 8. Right next to it is the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins grace.

Take the opportunity to get a few questlines up to speed. First warp back to Millicent on the Altus Plateau. Give her the Valkyrie's Prosthesis, then travel to the windmill village grace where you defeated the Godskin Apostle and talk to her there as well, then back to the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins and speak with her again. Then return to the Volcano Manor. Complete Diallos Hoslow's Jarburg quest and Rya's manor quest. You have to do this before the final Volcano Manor invasion, otherwise you'll miss out on some quest options involving Tanith and Rya. Once you're ready to end the Volcano Manor questlines, return to the Mountaintops Valley Ruins again and keep going north until you reach the frozen river where a giant patrols. Follow the river to the west, past the in-fighting enemies. There at the Shack of the Lofty is your final Volcano Manor invasion against Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood. Defeat him, then take the Spiritspring Jump just south of the shack.

You'll arrive at the Stargazer's Ruins. Summon your Spirit Jellyfish Ashes to unlock the treasure room and loot the chest with the Primal Glintstone Blade. Further south on the bridge are Corhyn and Goldmask. Say hello to them and keep riding going east. If you still have healing left, fight the Erdtree Avatar here, otherwise just keep going north-east over the next bridge and unlock the Snow Valley Ruins Overlook grace right next to the bridge and defeat the Erdtree Avatar after. Use the runes to level up and/or upgrade your weapon. You should be at around level 100 now and have a weapon at +20, or +9 in case of a Somber weapon. You can definitely take on Praetor Rykard now, even without using the Serpent-Hunter (which you should still use regardless).

Afterwards, return to the Snow Valley Ruins Overlook grace on the Mountaintops of the Giants and climb up to the broken bridge east of the grace. There is an invisible bridge that lets you enter the Heretical Rise with the Founding Rain of Stars in it. Then exit the Heretical Rise to the south, skip the Lord Contender's Evergaol and jump down to the graveyard below with the Spiritspring Jump. Keep on going to the First Church of Marika to the east. Pick up the Sacred Tear and talk to Melina at the grace. Then jump back up to the Evergaol and defeat Roundtable Knight Vyke.

Return to the Snow Valley Ruins Overlook grace once again and head west towards the graveyard. Run past the giant skeleton spirits, kill the Tibia Mariner for Helphen's Steeple and defeat the Death Rite Bird. You can climb down the mountain from there to the north and visit Castle Sol, right next to the Walking Mausoleum.

Don't bother fighting the two Lion Guardians, just run past them. Climb up the ladders and fight your way past the ballistae on the rooftops.
One of the buildings here has one of the artist paintings in it. Keep going until you reach the Church of the Eclipse grace and pick up the Eclipse Shotel. You can also pick up the Cerulean Amber Medallion +1 not far from the church. Then proceed further upstairs to fight Commander Niall.

If you find yourself needing more damage, you can get more Smithing Stone 7s near the First Church of Marika from a body on a chair, in the frozen river from a statue, and at the Moonlight Altar, where there are also some Smithing Stone 8s guarded by a Red Wolf of Radagon.

sections.heading: Step 20: Consecrated Snowfield
sections.markdown:
Warp back to the Grand Lift of Rold and use the "select other" left/right command to activate the Haligtree Secret Medallion instead of the regular Rold Medallion. You'll arrive at the Hidden Path to the Haligtree. You can fight a second Mimic Tear miniboss by jumping down onto the invisible platforms below the path with the Vulgar Militia.

Once you're outside, ride straight north until you arrive at the frozen river. On the opposite side of the river from the waypoint with the Consecrated Snowfield map is the Inner Consecrated Snowfield grace. Activate it and then travel west on the frozen river to fight Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater for the third time. You may also explore the area south-east and south-west of the grace to plunder the Caravans. There is also an additional one guarded by two Night's Cavalry that will drop the Night's Cavalry Armor set.

Further north of the frozen river is Ordina, Liturgical Town. You can stop there to activate the grace and pick up the Black Knife Armor set, but clearing the town is not the goal yet. East of the town is a Rotten Duelist enemy that drops the Rotten Greataxe.

In the far south-west behind the madness-infested Yelough Anix Ruins is the Yelough Anix Tunnel. Clear it if you want more Smithing Stones.

If you follow the frozen river to the north-west, you'll arrive at the Apostate Derelict with a Walking Mausoleum in front of it. This is the final location for Latenna's quest. There is a prompt to summon her in front of the NPC.

All the way to the west is the gateway portal to Mohgwyn Palace. It is guarded by some Runebears and an invader. Defeat the invader and enter the portal.

sections.heading: Step 21: Mohgwyn Palace
sections.markdown:
Exit the cave and touch the "Palace Approaching Ledge-Road" grace. This is your new best spot for Rune farming, either by making the bird in the nearby blood lake run of the cliff after shooting it with a bow, or by killing the Albinaurics near the grace.

You can skip most of the enemies here, but beware of the NPC invaders in the lake. Invasions cause you to dismount, leaving you stranded. In the lake are a bunch of useful items however: a Golden Seed, Smithing Stone 7 and 8, Ghost Glovewort 9, the Haligdrake Talisman +2, the Swarm of Flies spell and the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook 24.

Once ready to leave the lake behind you, ride past the Albinaurics that summon giant spirit skeletons and enter the Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum. Inside is an Imprisoned Merchant, but there are infinitely respawning Sanguine Nobles nearby that will interrupt you while shopping. Just go further up the stairs and touch the next grace, then fight the Sanguine Noble on the altar with a small army of red Albinaurics in front. On the altar is a chest with a rare Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

Up the elevator right next to the altar is Mohg, Lord of Blood, but we're taking detour back to Leyndell, Royal Capital before fighting Mohg. If you didn't already go there, it is now time to clear the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds beneath the capital. Finding Mohg's Shackle and defeating Mohg, the Omen are the main goals, but you can also meet the Dung Eater, fight Esgar, Priest of Blood and visit the Frenzied Flame Proscription where Hyetta is now. Do not open the door to the Frenzied Flame yet, it has an impact on the endings which we'll get to later.

Once you're through the Shunning Grounds, it is time to fight Mohg, Lord of Blood. Equip the Purifying Crystal Tear that you got way back from Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger to your Flask of Wondrous Physick for this fight, it will be useful, just like Mohg's Shackle.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.markdown: Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger** is an NPC invader in *Elden Ring*.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.markdown: Hailing from the Land of Reeds, Eleonora is the deadliest Bloody Finger and a partaker of Dragon Communion. She's a proud swordstress who felled many old hands, but now her legacy has been tainted by corrupted blood. Yura has been tracking Eleonora for a long time hoping of cleansing the knight of her cessblood.

sections.heading: Location
sections.markdown:
- Altus Plateau (Altus Highway Junction)

Invades inside the Second Church of Marika, north-west of the Site of Grace.

sections.heading: Questline Progression
sections.markdown:
1. Altus Plateau (Altus Highway Junction)
 - After helping Yura defeat Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin at the Main Academy Gate of Raya Lucaria, you'll find him moribund inside the Second Church of Marika; exhausting his dialogues, he'll die leaving behind his Nagakiba (with the Ash of War: Piercing Fang). Shortly after, Eleonora will invade you: defeating her will award you with her Poleblade and the Purifying Crystal Tear that counters Mohg, Lord of Blood's phase transitioning curse-attack.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.markdown:
- If the player enters the church before Yura moves inside, instead of Eleonora, they'll find a Sanguine Noble.
- If Morgott, the Omen King is defeated before Yura reaches the Second Church of Marika, he'll die leaving behind his Nagakiba at the Seaside Ruins Site of Grace in Limgrave and Shabriri will possess his body, moving at the Zamor Ruins Site of Grace in the Mountaintops of the Giants: at this point, Eleonora will invade regardless, at her usual location.
 - If you've also inherited the Frenzied Flame before getting to the Mountaintops, Shabriri won't appear, but the Ronin Set will be found in his spot.

These phantoms are the manifestation of those fragments and can be summoned by Fia even if the original champion they're sourced from is dead.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.markdown: The **Erdtree Seal** is a Sacred Seal and catalyst in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Acquisition
sections.markdown: Found inside a open cell down the town near the Prison Town Church grace, located in Volcano Manor. There is a Omenkiller enemy near it.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.markdown: - Does NOT increase the damage of Erdtree Incantations, despite the name and association with that incantation type.

sections.heading: Upgrading
sections.markdown:
- Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
- Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.
- The upper number in the Atk column denotes Physical base damage while the lower, colored number in the Atk column denotes elemental base damage: orange for Holy damage.
- See the Weapon Scaling page for what the scaling values mean.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.markdown:
- The Erdtree Seal is the strongest Faith-only Sacred Seal when the stat is above 68.
 - Gets 353 Incantation Scaling at 80 Faith when the seal is at +10. The other seals are in the 310 to 330 range at that point.
 - If using only a single Seal, other Faith-only Seals will still outmatch the Erdtree Seal when using the type of incantations that they boost. However, since this boost also applies to other Seals when a spell-boosting seal is held in an active hand, wielding two Seals at the same time makes the Erdtree Seal once again the stronger alternative unless two copies of the same spell-boosting seal are obtained.
- Though it won't quite catch up with the Godslayer's Seal (the strongest Seal beforehand) until the Faith stat reaches the 60s, the ease of upgrading it because it requires Somber Smithing Stones (versus the unfortunately generally much rarer Smithing Stones that the Godslayer's Seal needs) means it can still see good use beforehand.
- Besides increasing the Seal's Incantation Scaling, the Faith-scaling also increases the its own meager base Physical and Holy damage.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.markdown:
- The Erdtree crest mentioned in the description is the one temporarily created on the ground or in the air when casting Erdtree Incantations.
- This is the only Sacred Seal that also deals non-Physical damage when it's used to directly hit an enemy.

sections.heading: Acquisition
sections.markdown: Received upon defeating Necromancer Garris, who is found behind an illusory wall inside the Sage's Cave, located in Altus Plateau.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.markdown:
- While the weapon itself mostly scales with Dexterity, the skill actually scales with Intelligence and quite strongly at that in spite of the weapon's own E to D scaling for that Attribute.
- The Strength requirement is 8, which is the lowest the Attribute can go.
- As a Flail, this weapon can't be parried.
- Curiously enough, the skill does not consume Stamina upon casting, not even in combat.

- Can't be buffed or infused.

sections.heading: Trivia
